NCE P-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET 
Description 
The NCE01P13K uses advanced trench technology and 
design to provide excellent RDS(ON) with low gate charge. It can 
be used in a wide variety of applications. It is ESD protested. 
 
General Features 
● V DS =-100V,ID =-13A 
RDS(ON) <200mΩ @ VGS=-10V  (Typ:170m Ω) 
 
● Super high dense cell design 
● Advanced trench process technology 
● Reliable and rugged 
● High density celldesign for ultra low on-resistance 
 
Application 
● Power switch 
● DC/DC converters 
 
 
 
100% UIS TESTED! 
 
100% ∆Vds TESTED!
